sub: Who can do what in S3.

Overview.p: IAM policies give users, groups and roles permission to use S3 actions on specific buckets and objects.
The ID card system: IAM decides what each person is allowed to do in S3.
Developers get read-only access to one bucket, and an EC2 role writes logs to another.

items: Create a policy with S3 actions and the bucket ARN
Attach it to a user, group or role
The request is signed with credentials
